description: minimumReleaseAge holds a version bump for 3 days. Automerge reaches root-equivalent containers and arbites applies a merge within ~15 min, so an unheld bump could be live in one cycle with nobody in the loop.

internalChecksFilter is strict, so a too-young version opens no PR at all. vulnerabilityAlerts (renovate's own defaults, not configured here) clears minimumReleaseAge with prCreation immediate, so an OSV fix still lands at once. Digest updates and container images are exempt — see the rules below.

No global automergeSchedule: an automerged bump lands as soon as it is green, at any hour. plex alone is windowed — see the rule below. Landing no longer forces an open operator branch to rebase, main's ruleset having gone loose; .github/workflows/README.md covers what that trades away.

Squash merging must stay off in the repository settings, not only in main's ruleset: renovate takes its automerge method from the repo settings — squash first where allowed, then merge — and never reads the ruleset, so with squash on GitHub rejects every enablePullRequestAutoMerge call. Automerge then degrades rather than stops, falling back to renovate merging inside its own run: one PR per run, and only in a run that clears any schedule. That reads as a backlog, not a fault. Rebase merging is off for the repo's merge-commit convention, not for this.

customManagers.description: Container image refs pinned in role vars; quadlet templates render them.
The disaster-recovery runbook hardcodes the mariadb roles/wordpress pins, so its fallback SQL load runs on that engine. Same depName, so both bump in one PR.
Grafana dashboard revisions pinned in role vars; the role fetches them at converge.
Packer for the lint gate's packer-fmt/packer-validate hooks; no zypper package, and it cannot have one — cracklib owns the name.
Packer plugins, pinned exactly because packer init writes no lock file.

butane for the lint gate; the binary comes out of a digest-pinned image because the GitHub release ships signatures but no checksums. Butane now lives in coreos/ignition and coreos/butane is archived, so tags follow Ignition's version line: the 0.x -> 2.x jump is a renumbering, not years of drift.
tflint for CI and the workstation; no zypper package. One depName, so tflint_version and dev_tflint_version bump together.

OpenTofu for both workflows' setup-opentofu; the workstation takes the zypper package instead. One depName, so both bump together; terraform.yml's destructive-plan gate guards the apply a bump fires, so minor/patch automerge.
Hugo for peaceiris/actions-hugo in the Firebase and go.sum autofix workflows; the workstation takes the zypper package instead.
firebase-tools for the Firebase deploy workflows and the workstation; no zypper package. One depName, so the workflows and dev_firebase_tools_version bump together.
The ansible MCP server pinned in .mcp.json; no pip/zypper package.
required_version constrains the OpenTofu CLI, but the terraform manager mis-tracks it as hashicorp/terraform (disabled below). hashicorp versioning parses the ~> range.

packageRules.description: A major is the one update type nothing here automerges, so it lands as a PR waiting on a human; the label routes it through the claude review workflow first. addLabels merges rather than replaces, so unlike the rules below this one does not care where it sits in the order.
Grafana dashboard revisions are bare incrementing integers.
pinDigest carries no version change, so the lint check is enough to merge it unattended.

Renovate reads no releaseTimestamp for a digest (renovate#38656), and minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour defaults to timestamp-required, so these park forever on a stability-days check no elapsed time clears. Sets no automerge, so the cadvisor/caddy rule below still holds.
No registry read here returns a releaseTimestamp, so a container version bump parks the same way. The rule above covers digests on the other datasources, where the github-actions pins live.

No unattended bump where a compromised image reads the host or fronts the internet. cadvisor runs as root with a read-only bind of the whole host filesystem; caddy terminates TLS for the public sites, holds the Cloudflare API token, and alone publishes 80/443. node_exporter is deliberately absent: it mounts the host D-Bus system bus, but runs as an unprivileged uid systemd refuses StartTransientUnit, and its molecule verify asserts that user. Must stay after the pinDigest rule — later rules win, and flatten reapplies packageRules after the update-type presets, so this has the last word.

arbites installs this ansible and applies the fleet as root, so an unattended bump is unread root code on every host. Hashing the pin would not help: pip's hash mode is per-invocation, so it would force a hashed closure onto requirements-dev.txt too.
linuxserver images carry legacy build-number, two-part and four-part tags that docker versioning reads as upgrades; their releases are strict semver.
lidarr has a legacy 8.1.2135 tag that even strict semver accepts; mainline is 3.x.

Grouped so a batch of image bumps merges and applies once rather than per image. No window here: a restart at the wrong moment costs a re-verify or a re-run — see the plex rule below. Matched by file: the role's vars hold nothing else renovate manages, so a new container joins without a rule change.

A plex restart kills active streams, so it merges 02:00-06:00 — the first streams start at 06:00, and podman_backup's stop-every-container run is done by 01:01. autoupdate's 03:00 reboot sits inside the window deliberately: an apply racing it only fails the run, which arbites retries, where an apply during the backup would leave restic a half-written config volume. groupName null takes plex out of the group above, which would otherwise merge it at any hour. platformAutomerge must stay off beside the schedule: GitHub's native auto-merge lands a PR as soon as it is green and ignores automergeSchedule (renovate#21436). No vulnerability alert reaches this either — renovate maps the docker datasource to no OSV or Dependabot ecosystem.
google and google-beta release in lockstep, so two PRs are the same bump twice. matchDatasources keeps this off google-github-actions/auth.

Follows renovate's own release cadence, several a day — a fifth of all renovate traffic here for a lint-gate pin with no reach onto the fleet. schedule constrains creation, where automergeSchedule constrains landing.
Hard dep of hetzner.hcloud's vendored SDK, which imports dateutil.parser.isoparse. Stable, not abandoned — just release-inactive.

config:best-practices skips indirect gomod deps, so enable them for this go.mod or the Blowfish theme never updates. site-gate catches a break, and hugo-gosum-autofix completes go.sum and re-triggers it.
required_version is the OpenTofu CLI, not HashiCorp Terraform; the custom manager above tracks it.
